Investor Podcast - On The Rocks Episode 4

United Oil & Gas plc (AIM: UOG), the oil and gas company with a high-impact exploration asset offshore Jamaica and a development asset in the UK, is pleased to announce the publication of the fourth episode of its investor podcast series, On The Rocks.

In this episode, United's Jamaica Country Manager, Herona Thompson, joins United’s Chief Operating Officer Donal Meehan to discuss Jamaica's established energy and industrial infrastructure and its relevance to the Walton-Morant Licence offshore Jamaica.

The discussion highlights the potential benefits of Kingston Harbour and the established port, refining and power generation infrastructure located close to the Walton-Morant Licence. It also draws on United's recent operational experience in Jamaica, with the Company's offshore SGE survey having been mobilised from Kingston Harbour.
The podcast is available to view at: https://youtu.be/9TZzfi97h3w
Roland Cornish | Felicity Geidt | Asia Szusciak

The business is led by an experienced management team with a strong track record of growing full cycle businesses, partnered with established industry players and is well positioned to deliver future growth through portfolio optimisation and targeted acquisitions.
